4951.title: New-thread command panel routing
4951.rootCauseOneLine: RootComposeView does not publish its panel opener to the focused registry used by plugin commands.
4951.proposedFix: Publish the focused New thread opener, resolve the calling plugin's new-thread actions, and reuse existing validation and tab state.
4951.caveats: Functional jsdom reproduction; no release binary, real third-party plugin, or physical shortcut/browser check.
